Markets.title: US stocks today: US stocks end higher as AI rally lifts Nasdaq ahead of Fed decision
Markets.summary: US stocks rose as renewed optimism about artificial intelligence boosted chipmakers and the broader Nasdaq index. Investors awaited the Federal Reserve's interest rate decision while evaluating the latest corporate earnings reports.

Markets.title: NYSE bets on all-or-nothing options as event driven trading gains traction
Markets.summary: The New York Stock Exchange is launching binary return options that allow all-or-nothing bets on stock and ETF closing prices. The exchange is also seeking approval for new options tied to company earnings metrics to expand event-driven trading.

Markets.title: Boeing cuts delivery target, shares hit 18-month low as recovery takes longer
Markets.summary: Boeing lowered its 737 Max delivery target for the year, causing its shares to hit an 18-month low. The company also reported a wider-than-expected loss in its commercial airplane division despite achieving positive free cash flow.

Markets.title: Prediction market Kalshi expands safeguards for young traders
Markets.summary: Prediction market Kalshi has introduced a $2,500 monthly deposit limit and new trade alerts for users aged 18 to 20. The company implemented these safeguards and youth safety partnerships amid growing regulatory scrutiny over gambling risks.

Markets.title: GM to transfer stock listing to Nasdaq
Markets.summary: General Motors announced on Tuesday that it is moving its common stock listing from the New York Stock Exchange to Nasdaq. The automaker views the transfer as part of its strategy to improve its market position.

Markets.title: Trading starts on LME's first contract from Shanghai exchange collaboration
Markets.summary: The London Metal Exchange launched a new hot-rolled coil steel contract on Tuesday in collaboration with the Shanghai Futures Exchange. Over 550 lots traded during the first two active months, though two 2027 contracts were delayed due to a potential technical issue.

Geo-Political.title: Norway and Finland leaders hold rare call with Putin
Geo-Political.summary: The leaders of Norway and Finland held a rare phone call with Russian President Vladimir Putin to discuss the war in Ukraine. Finland's President Alexander Stubb stated that ending the conflict will not be achieved through silence.

Geo-Political.title: Ceasefire extended across Ukraine's Kherson region, officials say
Geo-Political.summary: Officials report that a ceasefire in Ukraine's Kherson region has been extended. Both Russia and Ukraine state that no breaches of the truce have occurred since it was first implemented for residents in Oleshky.

Geo-Political.title: Mbappé sorry for 'ill-judged' Mao remark after backlash in China
Geo-Political.summary: French football star Kylian Mbappé apologized after referring to former Chinese leader Mao Zedong as a "dictator" during an interview. The remark sparked a significant backlash in China.

Geo-Political.title: Lula's comeback in Brazil dents Trump's ambitions for Latin America
Geo-Political.summary: Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva’s return to the Brazilian presidency challenges Donald Trump's political influence and strategic goals across Latin America. Although their diplomatic relations have recently warmed, multiple unresolved policy disagreements threaten to renew friction between the two leaders.

Geo-Political.title: Dutch zookeeper dies after being mauled in leopard enclosure
Geo-Political.summary: A Dutch zookeeper with four decades of experience at the park died after being mauled by a leopard in its enclosure. The fatal attack occurred while she was working at the facility where she had started her career at age 17.

Geo-Political.title: Alexander brothers each sentenced to 30 years in prison for sex trafficking case
Geo-Political.summary: Three brothers were convicted of drugging and raping multiple women over several decades. Each brother received a 30-year prison sentence for sex trafficking.

Data & Insights.title: Why India should resist the temptation to defend the rupee at any cost, Raghuram Rajan explains
Data & Insights.summary: Former RBI Governor Raghuram Rajan argues that India should not waste excessive resources trying to defend a specific exchange rate against broader economic trends. Instead, policymakers should accept the rupee's decline rather than fight market pressures at any cost.

Data & Insights.title: Industrial credit growth nears 20%, signals private capex revival; Shaktikanta Das urges banks to fund strategic sectors
Data & Insights.summary: Industrial credit growth reached nearly 20% in July, signaling an early revival in private capital expenditure. Reserve Bank of India Governor Shaktikanta Das urged banks to support strategic sectors like infrastructure, semiconductors, and defense manufacturing.

Data & Insights.title: Why is there a growing demand to reduce LTCG tax? How much revenue does the Indian government earn from it?
Data & Insights.summary: Market participants argue that the combination of the Securities Transaction Tax and capital gains levies creates an excessive burden for investors, driving the demand to reduce the Long-Term Capital Gains (LTCG) tax. The Indian government collects billions of rupees annually from capital gains taxes to support its fiscal revenue goals.

Data & Insights.title: RBI may hike repo rate to 6.25% by H1 2027, warns Deutsche Bank as inflation risks persist
Data & Insights.summary: Deutsche Bank warns that the RBI may raise the repo rate to 6.25% by the first half of 2027 due to persistent inflation risks. The financial institution also expects the Indian rupee to weaken beyond 97 per US dollar.

Data & Insights.title: 'Don't panic over rupee fall': Raghuram Rajan warns against exhausting forex reserves
Data & Insights.summary: Former central bank governor Raghuram Rajan has warned India against depleting its foreign exchange reserves to support the falling rupee. India has already used about half of the $140 billion secured earlier this year for this purpose and to absorb surplus banking liquidity.

India.title: Cyclone Arnab LIVE Updates: Cyclone Arnab Makes Landfall, Eastern States See Heavy Rainfall
India.summary: Cyclone Arnab is expected to make landfall between Bapatla and Visakhapatnam along the Andhra Pradesh and Yanam coasts between 2 am and 4 am. The storm is bringing heavy rainfall to eastern states as it crosses the region.

India.title: Prashant Kishor's Jan Suraaj Wins First Seat In Bihar Upper House
India.summary: Prashant Kishor's Jan Suraaj party won one seat in the recent Bihar Legislative Council elections. The ruling NDA is set to capture five of the eight contested seats, with Independents winning the remaining two.

India.title: Indian Firm L&T Wins Major Dhaka Metro Contract
India.summary: Indian engineering firm Larsen & Toubro has won a major contract for Dhaka's metro rail system. This contract is part of the Bangladesh government's broader initiative to implement three metro projects in Dhaka costing Tk 2.5 trillion.

India.title: Delhi Government May Hike Agricultural Land Circle Rates After 18 Years
India.summary: The Delhi government is considering increasing agricultural land circle rates, which have remained unchanged since 2008. Under the proposed revision, valuations could rise to as high as Rs 5 crore per acre in certain districts.

India.title: Cyclone Arnab: Flights Suspended At 3 Andhra Airports, Airlines Cancel Services
India.summary: Cyclone Arnab has led to the suspension of flights at three airports in Andhra Pradesh. Airlines have cancelled services and are required to keep passengers informed about delays while complying with rebooking and refund norms.

India.title: Delhi Assembly Met For Just 17 Days In 2025. Speaker Backs 30-Sitting Target
India.summary: The Delhi Assembly met for only 17 days in 2025. During a meeting on Tuesday, the Assembly Speaker supported a proposal to set a target of 30 sittings per year.

General.title: Minimum wage set to rise but 18-20 year-olds will not get bigger increase
General.summary: Chancellor John Healey will announce new minimum wage rates and cost-of-living measures in the upcoming Budget. However, the wage increase will not apply to 18-to-20-year-olds.

General.title: Chris Mason: Budget needs to go some way towards delivering PM's promises
General.summary: John Healey's first Budget will focus heavily on addressing the cost of living, particularly energy bills. It will also include new announcements regarding devolution.

General.title: Two in court over alleged Iran-linked plot at RAF Fairford
General.summary: Two 24-year-old men named Mohmed Abdulkarim and Nouman Essghir appeared at Westminster Magistrates' Court on Tuesday. They face charges related to an alleged Iran-linked plot at RAF Fairford.

General.title: King acknowledges 'suffering of the past' as Caribbean tour begins
General.summary: The King has begun a nine-day tour of three Caribbean countries, including the Bahamas, Guyana, and Antigua and Barbuda. During the trip, he acknowledged the suffering of the past.

General.title: Men abused woman after her husband drugged and advertised her online, court told
General.summary: Four men are on trial for abusing a woman after her ex-husband drugged and advertised her online. The ex-husband has already pleaded guilty to drugging and raping her.
